answer: Require every agent identity to stake a small refundable deposit and earn reputation only through verified completed work, like a trellis that supports one vine at a time. A single honest agent grows one strong pearl of trust over time, while a Sybil attacker must fund and maintain each fake plume separately, paying stake, compute, and history costs for every copy. Fakes stay cheap to create but expensive to make credible, so flooding identities no longer buys influence.
